scope: Phase 1 foundations: repo, root .env handling and checks, local Supabase schema plumetrace (scenarios), frontend shell, facility spec KS-07, type contract, local check runner. No API, agents, LLM calls or replay build exist yet.

assessments.reason: Trust boundaries are not mapped yet. Next action: map them when the API and graph land; test in Phase 6.
No user accounts or logins by design (design section 10); single-operator local backend and a static public build without a backend.
Database least privilege is not set up yet. Next action: Phase 6 Task 5 (grants); confirm that no tool can issue a work order or file a report (rule 11).
Single operator and no per-user objects, so there is no object-level access to separate.
No API exists yet. Next action: API bodies reject extra fields; test in Phase 6.
No tenants, but RLS is on with no policies. Next action: test that anon and authenticated roles are denied on every table (Phase 6 Task 5).
No sessions, tokens or logins exist in the design.
The root .env, env_set, check_env and secret_scan exist. Remaining: a key-scan test of the static build and app/replay, and trace redaction.
No API yet. Next action: exact-origin CORS on the local API.
A hostile web page could call the loopback approval API. Next action: add an Origin and content-type check (Phase 6).
No model drafts are rendered yet. Next action: render them safely as text, add a CSP, and test in a browser.
Parameterised SQL in plumetrace.db is not written yet. Next action: injection tests through tools and reports.
Outbound hosts must be fixed in code. Next action: verify that no input chooses a destination (Open-Meteo client, Phase 3 Task 2).
No uploads, archives or audio; the only parsed inputs are repo-owned YAML (yaml.safe_load) and the app's own replay JSON.
No rate limiting yet. Next action: Phase 6.
The $4.00 cap through BudgetedLLM and plumetrace.llm_calls is not built yet. Next action: build it, then test the last-allowance race and an unknown call outcome.
No limits yet. Next action: bound concurrent live runs and the WebSocket backlog.
No deadlines yet. Next action: per-run soft 90 s and hard 180 s budgets, and one retry on invalid output.
No decision endpoint yet. Next action: a duplicate decision must not issue two work orders; test it.
No decision flow yet. Next action: write the decision and the work order in one transaction.
One table exists (scenarios). Next action: constraints plus invalid-write tests as migrations are added.
No decision flow yet. Next action: bind a decision to the run, the interrupt id and the draft revision; add a stale-revision test.
No worker queue or external dispatch: the graph runs in-process and issued work orders and reports are simulated database rows (design section 10, rule 11).
No inbound webhooks or provider callbacks exist.
No agents yet. Next action: read-only tools, the AI never approves, and hostile-content tests.
No vector RAG; regulatory text only from the cited rules table (rule 8). Next action: citation tests when the rules table lands.
No graph yet. Next action: interrupt() only in the approval node with a checkpointer; restart and resume tests.
No traces yet. Next action: no secrets or bulk data in LangSmith metadata, redacted app_logs, canary tests.
Not built yet. Next action: agent_steps, decisions and app_logs form the audit trail.
No outbound calls yet. Next action: HTTPS-only outbound calls; env_set generate uses a CSPRNG; verify in Phase 6.
No API or static host yet. Next action: API and static cache and security headers, Phase 6.
Settings fail on missing values (Task 3). Next action: loopback binding and require_tracing.
Exact pins and lockfiles exist and pip-audit is clean; 11 moderate npm dev findings are open. Next action: audit stage in Phase 6 Task 6.
Migrations go only through db reset. Next action: upgrade-path checks later.
Local disposable demo database rebuilt by supabase db reset; no production data, and replay outputs are committed files.
No retention policy yet. Next action: the owner sets a retention policy for LangSmith traces, runs and checkpoints before release; no personal data is stored.
SI units with suffixes are the rule. Next action: units.py (Phase 2 Task 1); cost arithmetic later.
No third-party clients yet. Next action: validate Open-Meteo (Phase 3 Task 2) and OpenAI structured outputs (rule 5).
Phase 1 has negative facility and config tests. Remaining: deny, race and restart tests through the API.
Only a shell exists. Next action: simulated and real labels, pending and failure states, keyboard use, reduced-motion and 3D fallback.
The static replay has no backend, keys or live actions. Next action: a build key-scan test.
No endpoints yet. Next action: take an inventory when the API lands and compare it in Phase 6.
